name: Sqrxz 4
author: Retroguru
description_short: The fourth hard-as-nails jump'n'think Sqrxz game, set on a cold icy island full of marbles, evil penguins and ghosts.
description_long: Sqrxz 4 - Cold Cash takes Sqrxz to a cold icy island with shiny marbles, evil penguins, ghosts, underwater creatures and more. It brings authentic retro graphics, 10 die-hard levels, 11 tunes, hidden passages, cheat codes for those who find them, a top-ten high-score table and unlimited continues.
